# Luminous

> Luminous is an open-source, lightweight desktop music player built for local audio library management and high-fidelity playback.

## Core Features
- Local audio library indexing & playback
- Support for lossless audio formats (FLAC, WAV, ALAC)
- Custom UI themes & customizable layouts
- Fast, low-resource performance

## Tech Stack & Architecture
- Framework: Tauri v2
- Frontend: React / TypeScript / Tailwind CSS
- Core Backend: Rust

## Key Links
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/esoltys/luminous
